shellCommands.command: npm run dev > /tmp/next-dev.log 2>&1 & sleep 12 && curl -s -i http://localhost:3000/ -o /tmp/resp.txt; grep -i 'x-request-id' /tmp/resp.txt; echo '--- dev log ---'; tail -20 /tmp/next-dev.log

(npm run dev > /tmp/next-dev2.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 10 && curl -s -i http://localhost:3000/about -o /tmp/resp2.txt; grep -i 'x-request-id' /tmp/resp2.txt; curl -s -I http://localhost:3000/ | grep -i 'x-request-id'; echo '--- log ---'; grep -E '^(/|⚠)' /tmp/next-dev2.log; pkill -f 'next dev' 2>/dev/null; true

sleep 2; (npm run dev > /tmp/next-dev3.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 12 && curl -s -I http://localhost:3000/about | grep -i 'x-request-id'; curl -s -I http://localhost:3000/ | grep -i 'x-request-id'; echo '--- log ---'; grep -E 'deprecated|^/' /tmp/next-dev3.log; pkill -f 'next dev'; true
